d: In part 2 of the video discussion on Presidential elections in India, Dr. Divyakiriti explains the method of counting of value of votes of MPs and MLAs (Article 55 of Indian constitution). vot dalne vale sansdon aur vidhaykon ke maton ki pramukhta bhi alag-alag hoti hai. ise ‘vetez’ bhi kaha jata hai. do rajyon ke vidhaykon ke voton ka ‘vetez’ bhi alag-alag hota hai. yah ‘vetez’ rajy ki jansankhya ke aadhar par tay kiya jata hai aur yah ‘vetez’ jis tarah tay kiya jata hai, use aanupatik pratinidhitv vyavastha kahte hain.
